Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to escalate its search queries effectively. Despite the directives to retrieve reliable and authoritative sources to verify Kujō Yoritsugu's paternal lineage, it repeatedly relied on the same or similar sources (e.g., Wikipedia and associated repetitive search queries) without expanding to higher-quality scholarly references like Britannica or other focused genealogical databases. This caused the agent to stagnate in its information retrieval and prevented progress beyond identifying Kujō Yoritsugu’s father (Yoritsune). This error type matches many of the characteristics outlined in the error signature of Example 5, where repetitive search patterns without progress or corroborated refinement of the answer led to incomplete resolution.
